about.story_headline: Small-batch woodworking from our Zurich studio
about.story: Every board and tray is milled from sustainably harvested hardwood, hand-sanded to 400 grit, and finished with organic beeswax.

listings.title: Cutting Board Wood Gift
listings.description: Nice handmade cutting board made from walnut wood. Great for gifts.

listings.title: Magnetic Knife Holder Wall Mount, Walnut Wood Knife Strip for Kitchen Organization
listings.description:
Keep your chef knives accessible with our solid American walnut magnetic knife strip. Embedded rare-earth neodymium magnets hold up to 8 heavy kitchen knives securely without scratching blades.

• DIMENSIONS: 16" x 2.5" x 0.85"
• MOUNTING: Includes hidden keyhole brackets + drywall anchors

listings.title: Personalized Espresso Tamper Station, Walnut Coffee Bar Organizer & Barista Gift, Custom Tamping Mat
listings.description:
Personalized walnut espresso tamper station handcrafted for 54mm and 58mm portafilters—an ergonomic coffee bar organizer and custom gift for home baristas and coffee lovers.

• DIMENSIONS: 9.5" x 6.0" x 2.2" solid black walnut
• COMPATIBILITY: Fits 51mm, 54mm (Breville), and 58mm commercial portafilters, distributor, tamper & puck screen
• FINISH: Water-resistant organic tung oil finish with non-slip silicone feet
• CARE & SHIPPING: Wipe clean with a damp cloth; ships within 2 business days.
